svg.title: Training pipelines for video discriminative, reward, and preference models
svg.desc: Complete editable reconstruction of the original three-row figure. Base frames are the three horizontal row regions, the three CogVideoX Backbone boxes, and the three legend boxes. Each row inventories two left video thumbnails labelled Real and Generated feeding a CogVideoX Backbone, latent stacks, LoRA adapters, MLP block, score/latent outputs, loss labels, and italic training captions. SAM picture assets map to thumbnail/photo regions: P004/P003 row 1, P006/P001 row 2, P005/P002 row 3, and P007 the small reference image near latent-space perturbations. Native SVG draft photo constructions are retained and independent SAM replacement groups reference the confirmed asset IDs at source-crop coordinates. The rows use horizontal equipartition; the second and third rows repeat the first-row pipeline with altered heads, legends, losses, and captions.

g.desc: Row 1 origin is the left real/generated video pair. Conduction moves rightward through two input arrows, the CogVideoX Backbone, latent stack z1...T, LoRA adapters, latent-space perturbation cue above, MLP block, compressed latents, and Lcontrast. The row is horizontally symmetric with row 2 and row 3, but uniquely includes the green latent-space perturbation bubble and compressed latents.

g.aria-label: Training the Reward Model on Aspect-Wise Scores
g.desc: Row 2 repeats the same left-to-right flow from real/generated video inputs through CogVideoX Backbone, latents, pink LoRA adapters, pink MLP block, aspect-wise scores, and LMSE. Its symmetry basis is horizontal alignment with the other rows, but it omits the perturbation bubble and uses a two-color initialization legend.
g.text: Training the Reward Model on Aspect-Wise Scores

g.aria-label: Training the Reward Model on Relative Preferences
g.desc: Row 3 repeats the left-to-right backbone and latent flow, but the LoRA adapters and MLP block are lavender, the aspect-wise scores pass to a vertical Linear Head, and the final loss is LBT. Its horizontal equipment mirrors row 2 while adding the separate linear-head frame before the loss.
g.text: Training the Reward Model on Relative Preferences
